hookups.source: No operator page exists (lizziescampground.com is a HugeDomains for-sale page, read 2026-10-21; Google Maps lists no other site). The stored 30 A / water / sewer were derived from note prose that rests only on directory listings (Campendium, RoverPass), so they are cleared.

sites.source: Same as hookups: the pull-through value rests only on directory listings; no operator page exists (read 2026-10-21).

note: South New Berlin, on the Unadilla River; opened 2020, pet-friendly. Directory listings (not the operator) describe back-in and pull-thru 30A sites with full, water/electric and dry hookups. No website of its own (the old domain is for sale); phone from its Google listing. --Claude
summary: No operator website or booking engine exists: lizziescampground.com is still a HugeDomains for-sale page. Google Maps shows 'Lizzie's Campground Corporation', 1741 County Hwy 18, 4.3 stars from 35 reviews, phone 607-548-4044 (matches the entry), so the presence rule's Google path is met. No 2024+ operator rate exists anywhere (AAA lists $30-55 a night), so fees stay empty. Cleared aggregator-only hookups and pull-through; dropped the RV Life rating line from the note (rating holds it). Booking.reservable left as is (no operator statement either way). Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Lake George 168 km); the family has not stayed here.
flags: Missing website: the operator has no website or booking page at all (lizziescampground.com is a HugeDomains for-sale page, read 2026-10-21). Presence rule met only via Google Maps: open listing 'Lizzie's Campground Corporation', 4.3 stars / 35 reviews, phone 607-548-4044.

No posted 2024+ rate from the operator (no site; AAA's directory lists $30-55/night). The price indicator is only RV Life's $$ tier. No gateway within 40 km, so a rate over US$50 would fail the gate; a phone call is the only way to confirm.
